_about: TUTORIAL ISLAND (owner 2026-10-28): the shared island every NEW survivor lands on after character creation, before owning a Tamed Island. Kind 'tutorial': permanent, never a sail route, never a home. Everything the tutorial orders (objectives.json 'tutorial') need is here: the standard camp (fire, bench, shed), a stone fire pit, herbs and berries by the camp (Tutorial.dress), and a few weak animals in the gathering ring. # ASSUMPTION: grassland climate at tier 15, the smallest landmass band IslandShape has (330 x 265 m), level 1 everywhere; seed and creature rows are this build's own.
